+# Core state repair, 2026-11-10
+
+Scope: CPU-only changes to the approved core fixes in the environment-review task.
+No GPU, live serving, performance or answer-quality qualification was performed.
+The external runtime was used read-only; no dependency installation or runtime
+modification was performed. Nothing was published remotely.
+
+## Behavior exercised
+
+- Same-incarnation registration requires a strictly greater generation. Refused
+  duplicates preserve the current observation, memory accounting and replay state.
+  A different incarnation replaces the session and can restart at generation zero.
+- Accepted hint events retain immutable decisions and ready/refreshed counts in
+  both advice modes. Exact replay after expiry returns those counts without another
+  cache scan or mutation. Conflicting content refuses. A new turn invalidates the
+  old observation and clears its events; reset and retirement invalidate them too.
+- ObservedStore owns event, session, retirement and accounting mutations. Readers
+  receive immutable observations rather than mutable session dictionaries.
+- Constructors validate names, generations, timestamps, boundaries, keys, settings
+  and outcome consistency; parser and direct-construction invalid cases refuse.
+- A fixed 64 MiB accounting budget covers retained session/key/event charges.
+  Tests exercise memory-driven retirement, oversized replacement refusal without
+  data loss, event refusal before cache mutation and replay while capacity is full.
+  This is an accounting policy, not a measured resident-memory ceiling.
+- Mechanism attribution retains actual CPU capacity and advice/observation limits.
+  Unimplemented feature labels and the unused store_threshold setting are removed.
+
+## Validation
+
+Portable full acceptance: 33 CPU tests passed; nine groups passed, two groups
+(native and runtime) explicitly skipped. No check was weakened and no exception
+was added. Test inventory additions and the constructor-test relocation were
+reviewed; no existing test was removed.
+
+Rule proofs: all 106 passed. Strict adapter/runtime-test typing passed for 13
+source files. The pinned CPU integration inventory passed all 13 tests, including
+scheduler replay after expiry and authenticated endpoint delivery. Runtime pytest
+used CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, disabled plugin autoload and disabled bytecode
+writes. Existing CPU scheduler tests verify CUDA remains uninitialized.
+
+The full external-attempt runtime verifier was not run: this task was restricted
+to the checkout. Runtime checks above are direct strict typing and inventory-gated
+pytest, without a new immutable functional-attempt receipt. The earlier GPU evidence
+in FINDINGS does not qualify these changes.
+
+## Repairs during validation
+
+The first direct check invocation lacked development tools on PATH and stopped;
+the checkout virtual environment was then placed on PATH. Intermediate type errors
+in malformed-input tests were repaired. A local variable name collided with
+Vulture's project-wide attribute detection and made an existing exception appear
+stale; renaming the variable restored the unchanged check. The first rule-proof
+run passed 101 tests and failed five positive controls because a copied contract
+test imported modules absent from the isolated fixture. Moving non-contract
+constructor tests into the advice tests repaired all five. An acceptance run
+concurrent with rule proofs also scanned temporary specimens during dependency
+inspection; final acceptance and proofs run sequentially. These failed checks did
+not represent performance measurements and were not reported as passes.
